lines.text: 在这曾被称为人性的野蛮屠场里，文明仍有微光。
lines.en: There are still faint glimmers of civilization left in this barbaric slaughterhouse that was once known as humanity.
lines.note: 古斯塔夫的文明宣言：粉红对称世界里最锋利的一句悲观乐观主义。
